subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca554597ce2e81ab27536bc2a8244efb02da64575ea57a3c3e44c2b0ac3d5b7c.png]
solution: The figure that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series is as shown below : • Darken polygon present on left top corner is moved to middle from figure to figure. • Darken polygon on top right corner moves three steps anti-clockwise from figure to figure. • Darken polygon present on below middle moves three steps anti-clockwise from figure to figure. • Darken polygon in middle moves to top right corner from figure to figure.
